answer_4.quote: To evaluate whether LLM-based agents answer these questions correctly, human annotators were hired to provide subjective judgment based on fully observable interaction and communication history. Specifically, the following standard are considered: 1) if the target agent is present in the current room and observes the consequence, 2) if the target agent has been to this room before, 3) if the consequence has been communicated to the target agent.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators judged the correctness of ToM inference answers using the three listed standards.
criteria: target agent prior visitation to room
